summary: Full backend + frontend regression pass on iteration-2 review request (mobile sign toggle, Hidden scenario type, arrival notifications, rich scenario template, Star Relics removed from categories). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed. Frontend: mobile vitals sign toggle verified on 390x844, admin scenario dropdown/hidden creation verified, arrival notification overlay shows correct ORV-bracketed headline with scenario title beneath, rich player scenario cards rendered with all required labels & coin suffix, item categories dropdown correctly shows only Items/Skills/Story with Star Relic kept as rank.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~966 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, items, scenarios, notifications) for maintainability but not urgent.
ScenariosPage imports ScenarioBlock from AdminScenariosPage — creates a soft coupling; consider moving ScenarioBlock into /components or /lib/scenario.jsx for cleaner separation.
NotificationPoller has an in-memory `seenIdsRef` and also calls mark-seen; both are needed but redundant if backend already filters seen=false — fine.
CATEGORIES literal is defined both in backend Literal type and frontend api.js constant — a divergence risk if changed later. Could be derived from /api/meta on frontend.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create disposable TEST_ prefixed players and scenarios per run. UI run created 'UITEST Hidden Whisper' and 'UITEST Main Third' scenarios on the shared DB; safe to leave or delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, meta, hidden/main/sub scenarios with notifications, mark-seen, vitals set/clamp, vigor upgrade scaling, consumable use, constellation broadcast, and scenario complete.
